fixes.explanation: Jesus doesn't mention fasting or rain at all. He says they were 'eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage.' That's ordinary life, going on right up to the day Noah entered the ark. Nobody in this passage is praying for rain, friend. They're busy with regular life.

Yes, baker. Jesus says the wicked servant 'begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.' That's what Jesus tells us he does. Giving the others their food at the proper time is what the faithful servant does (Matthew 24:45).
